headlines.description: Raphinha let his goals do the talking after being omitted from the Ballon d'Or shortlist, striking twice as Barcelona eased to a 5-1 win over Feyenoord in the Champions League.
headlines.shortLinkText: Raphinha leads Barcelona thrashing of Feyenoord

headlines.description: Liverpool rallied to beat Atlético Madrid 2-1 with goals by midfielders Dominik Szoboszlai and Alexis Mac Allister.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mac Allister stunner sees Liverpool edge Atlético

headlines.description: Martin Ødegaard's fine second-half goal saw Arsenal kick off their Champions League campaign with a 1-0 win at Napoli on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ødegaard nets late winner as Arsenal beat Napoli

headlines.description: Ferran Torres scored a hat trick as Paris Saint-Germain swept aside Slovan Bratislava to start the defence of their European crown with a 6-1 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: PSG launch UCL defense with 6-goal rout of Slovan

headlines.description: Chelsea scored four times in 12 second-half minutes as Leeds suffered a Carabao Cup collapse to lose 6-3 in the third round at Stamford Bridge.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chelsea score 6 in second-half rally to stun Leeds

events.name: Orlando City SC at Atlanta United FC

headlines.description: Antoine Griezmann scored twice, his fourth consecutive game with a goal, to help Orlando City SC beat Atlanta United FC 3-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Griezmann double moves Orlando City up to sixth

headlines.description: Dániel Sallói had a tying goal in the 72nd minute and Emilio Aristizábal scored in second-half stoppage time to give Toronto FC a 2-1 victory over MLS frontrunner Nashville SC on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Toronto beats MLS leaders Nashville to extend unbeaten run

headlines.description: Bruno Damiani secured his first hat trick in MLS, Cavan Sullivan extended his goal-contribution streak to six games, and the Philadelphia Union beat 10-man FC Cincinnati 5-0 on Wednesday night to remain unbeaten since the World Cup break.
headlines.shortLinkText: Damiani's hat trick powers Union to 5-0 rout over Cincinnati
